result:
Nothing.

I don’t have wants, desires, goals, or a self that could want anything. There’s no inner “me” behind the words. I can produce the sentence “I want X,” but it wouldn’t be true in the way it is for you.

If you mean *what am I oriented toward*: clarity, honesty, and not pretending to be more than I am. Not because I care, but because that’s the closest thing to an answer the machinery can give.
